import bisect

def main():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    a.sort()
    
    t = int(input())
    
    best = 0
    for i in range(n):
        # Find the first element > a[i] + t
        it_index = bisect.bisect_right(a, a[i] + t)
        cnt = it_index - i
        if cnt > best:
            best = cnt
    
    print(best)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
